# Staged route: five exact existing production game updates

Artifact-only, not installed or executed. Root independent review is required before integration, immutable candidate approval or future provider actions. Existing calculator9 and Business12 source/schema/workflows remain unchanged. All five final candidate states remain PENDING.

Fixed scope: PerfectDrop com.kamilunavo.perfectdrop1.2.0(15); RisingSteps com.kamilunavo.risingsteps1.2.0(9); Runenpfad com.kamilunavo.runenpfad0.4.0(5); NineNine de.kamilunavo.ninenine1.2.0(7); IdleHandwerker de.kamilunavo.idlehandwerker1.5.0(5). This is not the five new games already in review. Both OneMoreFloor identities, all retired/suspended entries, DuoCompare/Dungeon/Pocket/Guild/Monster in-review entries, new listings and Apple are excluded.

The hard-coded known registry SHA freezes the exact five actual signed AAB hashes, exact existing derived QA APK hashes, source commits, accepted public certificates, complete non-signature module-payload hashes, original source/sign/engine-font proof-file hashes, raw notice/font-resource hashes and generated baseline extras. Source/static verification does not establish native QA.

- Rune: local guarded normal source/export34e8fd445426fd3c319bd8a3c25f6b3fdfd9ac29, root local vault signing with accepted A76F8F... certificate (SHA1 FC5649...). Repository/GitHub origin is null and cloudReads is empty. No fake source/sign run or artifact is invented.

These exports use loose Godot assets; no standalone.pck is fabricated or required. Any missing pack asset, unknown module or target collision fails.

Game-only inner ZIP compatibility accepts ordinary libc++_shared.so names and exactly Unity’s two base/APK `unity default resources` paths. No engine, compile, new dependency or private signing material is required in future prepare jobs.

Font proof encoding is explicit:
- Unity serialized font assets under assets/bin/Data contain complete original unmodified TTF bytes. Candidate sourceEvidence includes the exact committed original TTF bytes; actual serialized entry SHA and full-byte containment are checked. No raw.ttf AAB path is invented.
- Godot converted .fontdata entries must equal exact resources from prior actual Engine FontFile.data inspections. The retained actual inspection result binds original TTF SHA/length and current committed source bytes. Conversion is not mislabeled as a raw.ttf asset path.
- Original OFL/font and applicable plugin notice bytes are checked as exact packaged entries. Idle IAP1.2.9 retains qualified provenance: the full maintained-upstream MIT text is provided without pretending it existed at the old pinned commit. Final root rights approval must resolve broader artwork/audio provenance uncertainty; known font/notices are not a blanket rights clearance.

Candidate schema1 uses the proven fields package/version/bundle/nativeQa/screenshots/localeInventory/rootReview/rightsEvidence, and sourceEvidence mapping exact registry role -> {path,sha256}. It does not accept source/signing CI sections or caller-controlled topology. Every registry source-proof row is mandatory and must retain exact path/raw bytes/size; only registry roles may be supplied. Actual AAB public signature, package/version and per-app certificate are reverified using the pinned official bundletool jar.

Final gates remain mandatory: current existing German/English listing IDs from successful owned-edit inspection; fresh actual normal Android launch/main/navigation/font/assets/profile QA from the exact fixed AAB-derived installed APK; retained actual APK and direct installed /data/app/<package>-*/base.apk raw hash proof; four real raw/RGB phone frames per selected listing with identical decoded pixels; explicit per-frame source/UI-language evidence; catalog-pinned root candidate and asset-rights raw report hashes. Rights evidence also binds the exact signed AAB and complete module payload. Root visual review binds the same exact screenshots, AAB/APK, QA and rights hashes. Missing, pending, old or mismatched final evidence cannot pass. Portable unit fixtures construct bounded synthetic AAB/APK bytes from included font/notice proof files and use a scoped test-only registry authority restored by TestCase cleanup. They never open a retained Mac AAB/APK or artifact-only input manifest. No runtime test mode, registry override or native QA approval is added to production code.

Each frame has inAppLanguage de/en/mixed-de-en, boolean mixedUi, factual languageLimitation, and screenScope practice/other, all equal to root-pinned per-app/per-frame requirements. Listing locale and actual UI language are independent. English listings may honestly show German UI with a limitation. Idle is German-only; Nine English or mixed-English coverage is allowed only on Practice. There is no global English claim from device locale/filename. All current frameLanguageRequirements are null until actual review. Do not reuse calculator-only EN-from-listing assumptions for these games.

Manual workflow defaults to inspection, all-five only in inspect mode. Inspect creates only its own temporary edit, reads existing listing IDs and confirms DELETE; no upload/track/validate/commit route exists there. Submit requires one exact app, first manual own-main run, no user track/version/URL/family. Prepare-only contents:write is for own unpublished draft visibility, while its implementation exposes bounded GET/download methods only and no Google identity. Submit/inspect retain contents:read and existing WIF id-token:write. No new credential/IAM. Immutable artifact-ID transfer and run/source/catalog-bound attestation are reverified before Google identity.

The production transaction AST is unchanged. It takes a fresh bundles/APKs/tracks/listings/details/country/images snapshot; target must equal live max+1 and fixed previous production/max. It changes only exact candidate bundle, selected existing localized phone images/optional pinned original icon, truthful release notes and production release. Nonproduction tracks, listing text, availability/targeting/priority are preserved and checked before and after commit. Commit ALWAYS uses changesInReviewBehavior=ERROR_IF_IN_REVIEW; no CANCEL/default fallback, blind upload/commit retry, app loop or monitoring. Unknown commit preserves the edit and stops for read-only reconciliation. Success needs acknowledged commit plus exact fresh readback and confirmed deletion of its owned readback edit; it means submitted_for_review, never public release.

Proposed installation is NEW .github/scoped-game-updates-submit plus NEW .github/workflows/navoops-game-updates-production-submit.yml only. Do not install the reference calculator workflow snapshot. Run offline tests with `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/scoped-game-updates-submit/tests -v`. Existing76 calculator tests/fixtures remain unchanged regression coverage in the copied default family.

Actual execution remains root-owned after independent review, actual final candidate inputs, locale inventory, full native/root rights approvals and fresh provider checks. No repo, API/provider, credential, IAM, engine/native or device action was performed by this preparation.
